about: Single source of truth for every art file. The game loads the first of public/<roots.licensed>/<path>, public/<roots.cc0>/<path>, public/<roots.placeholder>/<path> that exists with the right size. `kit` says where the file comes from in the CraftPix kit (npm run assets:import). Edit this file, then run `npm run assets:placeholders && npm run assets:docs`.

craftpix-td-kit.name: CraftPix: Tower Defense 2D Game Kit
craftpix-td-kit.licence: craftpix.net licence: usable in commercial and personal projects; the raw files must NOT be redistributed, and the files may not be used to train AI. Keep them in public/assets/licensed/ (gitignored).

own.name: Tower Defense original (placeholder generator)
own.licence: MIT, same as the code. Fine to commit.
